Ordinance No. 15240 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 91 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 91 was established by Ordinance No. 15240, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 2, 1976. Ordinance No. 15240 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the 1960 Revised Code of Civil and Criminal Ordinances of the City of Dallas. Ordinance No. 15240 was amended by Ordinance No. 17613, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 17, 1982, and Ordinance No 21271, passed by the Dallas City Council on April 22, 1992. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 15240; 17613; 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 91 is established on property generally located at the southwest corner of Royal Lane and the Dallas North Tollway. The size of PD 91 is approximately 8.378 acres. (Ord. Nos. 15240; 25423)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-91.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25423)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must comply with the site plan labelled Exhibit 91A. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.105.USES. The PD may be used for single-family detached residential dwellings and private park, as indicated on the site plan. Within the area designated as private park, the following uses are permitted: swimming pool, tennis courts, cabana with shelters, restrooms, equipment and material storage, greenhouse, children’s play area, and off-street parking to serve the facilities. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Subdivisions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.106.SUBDIVISIONS. Prior to issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat, as approved by the city plan commission, must be filed for record with the County Clerk, Dallas County, Texas. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.107.DENSITY. A maximum of 32 dwelling units are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.108.BUILDING SETBACKS. All buildings must be set back as indicated on the site plan. No building may be closer than 10 feet to any dedicated street, with the exception of Lot 6 in City Block A/5506, which may have a rear yard setback within four feet of the west right-of-way line of the Dallas North Tollway, and Lot 11 in City Block A/5506, which may have a front yard setback of no less than eight feet from the east right-of-way line of Royal Way. A zero side yard is permitted on one side of each individually platted lot as indicated on the site plan, with a minimum side yard of six feet for the remaining side yard on all lots except Lot 11 in City Block A/5506, which may have a remaining side yard of no less than four feet. A minimum rear yard of 15 feet must be provided except where lots are served by a paved access drive, in which case a minimum rear yard of three feet must be provided, and also except for Lot 6 in City Block A/5506, which may have a minimum rear yard setback of four feet, as indicated on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.109.SCREENING. A masonry screening wall not less than seven feet in height must be provided along all property lines except the south property line, as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Street Dedication
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.110.STREET DEDICATION. All residential lots must be served by a dedicated street with a minimum right-of-way of 46 feet. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.111.PAVING. Paving for all public streets, auto courts, and parking areas must meet the specifications and requirements of the department of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.112.PARKING. Parking must be provided at a ratio of two spaces for each single-family detached dwelling unit. Parking for the area designated as private park must be as indicated on the site plan. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.113.HEIGHT. No structure within the PD may exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.114.COVERAGE. Maximum lot coverage (ground floor) is 60 percent of the total lot area. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.115.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the non-business regulations in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: Homeowners’ Association
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.116.HOMEOWNERS’ ASSOCIATION. A homeowners’ association must be created by the developer for the proper care and maintenance of the common areas and facilities. The instrument creating the homeowners’ association must be approved by the city attorney, submitted to the city plan commission, and filed in the deed records of Dallas County, Texas, prior to the sale of any lot or tract. (Ord. Nos. 21271; 25423)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-91.117.GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.
(a)All development and use of the property within this PD must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.
(b)All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications adopted for such purpose to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.
(c)No certificate of occupancy shall be issued by the building official until there has been full compliance with this article in accordance with the requirements of the building for which the certificate is issued, and any applicable provisions of the zoning ordinance and the building codes. (Ord. Nos. 15240; 21271; 25423; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-91.118.ZONING MAP. PD 91 is located on Zoning Map No. E-7. (Ord. Nos. 17613; 25423)
